title: Photobooth | Free Online Photobooth Anytime, Anywhere
description: Take instant photobooth-style photos online. Customize with over 100 frame colors, add stickers and frames, and download high-quality photo strips instantly.

faqs.question: 14+ layouts & filters
faqs.answer:
Classic strips, Dog Filter, Hearts Filter, the Student ID Card
                            template, Studio Mode, and seasonal collabs. There's a style for every mood.

faqs.question: Full customization
faqs.answer:
Over 100 frame colors, drag-and-drop stickers, Doodle Mode, date
                            overlays, and logo language options. Make every strip your own.

faqs.question: Studio Mode
faqs.answer:
Capture longer, extra-polished poses and get a bonus
                            behind-the-scenes video clip, delivered to your phone with a quick QR scan.

faqs.question: Privacy first
faqs.answer:
Your photos are processed and saved locally in your browser.
                            Nothing is uploaded or stored on our end.
